name: Roaring Rage
body:
You bellow powerfully when raging.

Prerequisite: Rage class feature.

Benefit: For the duration of your rage, all creatures within 100 feet of you suffer a penalty to listen-based Perception checks equal to 10 + your Charisma modifier.
